dogecoin.text:
Both @WebullGlobal and @Gemini are paying to be in my Twitter feed this evening to tell me they support dogecoin trading. 

What a time to be alive.

3:30am pickup to catch my flight to Miami, and the private driver I booked has dogecoin price ticking on a screen next to the one with maps. Will I make it the whole hour to the airport without talking about crypto?
